note: Floors for the dev split, edited by hand at each milestone: raise them when the engine improves, never lower one to hide a regression. Only dev has floors; no test reads the validation or the locked split. Measures are fractions between 0 and 1; the names are the keys of FLOOR_METRICS in packages/domain/test/evaluation/floors.ts. Set at engine 2026.4.0 from the dev run (recall 0.460, precision 0.929, action recall 0.193, action precision 0.941, negation accuracy 0.395, negation silence 0.987). One correction, made openly: negationAccuracy was first written as 0.5, a figure no engine ever reached (0.332 with the Wave 1 detectors, 0.395 now), so it guarded nothing; it now sits at what the engine reaches, and the shortfall against 0.5 is reported in docs/EVALUATION.md. That measure mixes the engine's silence on sentences that do not state a fact (negationSilence, 0.987) with its recall of facts that are stated (0.28), which is why negationSilence is floored on its own.
